'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 2 Reid Smith DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif|label=A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage}}
* '''Username:''' 3MW0J8
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
